title: Layered Latency Attribution Board — kernel/network/batch attribution by model & route (streaming vs sync)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a composable ‘Layered Latency Attribution Board’ that decomposes end-to-end latency into: kernel/runtime execution, batching/queueing, network (ingress/egress), and trace/span overhead. The board should present p50/p95/p99 by model and route, side-by-side streaming vs non-streaming (sync) modes, and expose filters for customer, region, and request shape (tokens.in, messages.count). Goals: 1) make root-cause attribution actionable for on-call and SREs, 2) enable product/PM to spot regressions after model rollouts, and 3) provide knobs for autoscaling/tuning guidance (batch size, max inflight) with historical context.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard surfaces model x route grid with p50/p95/p99 rows and columns for streaming vs sync. 2) Each cell shows stacked attribution bars (kernel/runtime | batch/queue | network | trace overhead) that sum to observed pX value within 5% error. 3) Clicking a cell opens trace links and top contributing spans/ops. 4) Query backends are instrumented (metrics + span tags) and added to metric catalog. 5) Panel supports time-range compare and ability to pin alerts for thresholds (p95 > SLA).
implementation_notes: - Add span tags: serve.path, model.name, io.mode (stream|sync), request.tokens, batch.size. - Emit per-request 'serve_path_breakdown' histogram with labeled buckets for kernel_ms, batch_ms, net_ms, trace_ms. - Pipeline: Kafka topic 'telemetry.servepath.breakdowns' -> processor adds normalized fields -> longterm metrics store (ClickHouse) + tracing link index (ElasticSearch). - Dashboard built in Observability Console using query templates. - Ensure low-cardinality labels: avoid freeform user IDs in metrics; use hashed user buckets where needed.
tasks: Instrument runtime to emit breakdown spans and histogram events (runtime team)
Add Kafka processor to normalize breakdown messages and enrich with route-model mapping (infra team)
Create ClickHouse materialized views for p50/p95/p99 by [model, route, io.mode]
Design console panels and interaction flows (open trace, compare ranges, pin alerts)
Add alerting recipe for p95 regression tied to recent model rollouts
Add dashboard access controls and usage quota to avoid explosion in queries

review_comments: PM (Elena S): Prioritize top 20 customer routes in initial rollout to limit cardinality and cost.
SRE (Diego M): Ensure materialized views use TTL retention for high-cardinality combos; recommend 90-day raw retention and 1-year aggregated retention.
Design (Priya K): Add clear affordance to toggle 'show percent' vs 'show ms' and export CSV for investigations.
Runtime lead (Nikhil P): Kernel attribution relies on new timing hooks — landed in runtime v1.19; need coordination for rollout with Dedicated clusters.
risks_and_mitigations: High cardinality if we include unconstrained labels -> mitigate by precomputing top-N and hashing low-volume customers
Sampling mismatch across traces and metrics -> mitigate by using deterministic reservoir sampling keyed to request id
Dashboard query cost -> mitigate with materialized aggregates and query caching; limit ad-hoc time ranges by default
